label: Hermes Agent
description: One conversation with Hermes Agent, Nous Research's agent: three conversations are three nodes. Wire `agent` and `stream` into an AskAgent and talk to it in a Loop; end the loop with a CloseBus on `stream`, which ends this node's part of the run. With no `computer`, Hermes Agent runs on your machine (a local install only), working in `folder`. If `hermes` is missing, weft installs it into a folder of its own, shared by the whole machine, before the node runs. With a `computer` wired, it is installed and run inside that computer, which a cloud install needs. Either way it logs in with the connection on `access`. It always runs on the connection's login, in a home of its own: your machine's own Hermes may borrow your Claude Code and Codex logins, and its background daemon is shared with everything else that runs Hermes there. So `model` is always required, and the first start of a conversation sets up that home, which takes about 130 MB and some 11 seconds when weft installed Hermes (the downloads come from a cache every conversation shares), and about 440 MB with your own Hermes. Ordinary commands never ask in any setting; a command on its dangerous list does. The background model calls it makes on every turn (a better title, a self review) are off. Your program's tools reach the model under their own names, and one named like a Hermes tool takes that tool's place, except the tools Hermes runs itself whatever is registered (`clarify`, `delegate_task`, `manage_connections`, `memory`, `patch`, `session_search`, `todo_list`, `write_file`): a program tool with one of those names is refused. Its card shows what it is doing and a Start over button. What is exposed: the permission mode, the model and the reasoning effort.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: A Computer to run Hermes Agent in. Left out, it runs on your machine, which only a local install has. Several agents may share one computer.

inputs.name: access
inputs.description: A HermesAgentAccess's `access`: a model provider's key (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, or an OpenAI-compatible server). Required, because this agent never runs on a login already on your machine.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.label: Folder
inputs.description: The folder Hermes Agent works in. On your machine it is required, and must exist. In a computer it is a path inside the computer, its home folder when left out.

inputs.name: program
inputs.label: Program
inputs.description: On your machine: the Hermes Agent program to run, when it is not the `hermes` on your PATH or the one weft installs (an install of your own, a version you keep for this). A path on your machine, so it cannot go with a `computer`.

inputs.name: permission
inputs.label: Permissions
inputs.description: What Hermes Agent may do without asking. `ask`: every edit and every dangerous command comes out of AskAgent as a question. `accept_edits`: edits in the folder go ahead, dangerous commands ask. `auto`: every edit goes ahead, dangerous commands still ask. `bypass`: nothing asks, nothing is refused; for a computer, which is the wall around it.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The model id its provider names it by: `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5` on OpenRouter, `claude-sonnet-4-5` with an Anthropic key. Required.

inputs.name: streamBy
inputs.label: Stream by
inputs.description: What goes out on `stream`: `message`, one event per whole message, tool use and result, so a run waiting on a long step sleeps; `token`, every piece of text as it is written too, which keeps the run awake while the agent writes.

inputs.name: effort
inputs.label: Reasoning effort
inputs.description: How hard the model reasons; a model that does not reason ignores it. Left out, the model's default.

outputs.name: agent
outputs.description: The agent's handle: wire it into AskAgent's `agent`. Baked: made when the infra is started.

outputs.name: stream
outputs.description: Everything the agent does in this run, as AskAgent sends it. Wire it into every AskAgent of the loop, and into a CloseBus after the loop: the run's part of this node ends when it does.

then.message: HermesAgent '{id}' runs on the machine weft runs on, which a cloud install does not have; wire a Computer into `computer`.
HermesAgent '{id}' runs only on a connection's login: your machine's own Hermes may borrow your other agents' logins; give it a HermesAgentAccess on `access`.
HermesAgent '{id}' works on your machine, so it needs a `folder` to work in.
HermesAgent '{id}' refuses a conversation with no model; set `model` to the model id its provider names it by.
HermesAgent '{id}' has a `permission` it does not know; pick one of ask, accept_edits, auto, bypass.
HermesAgent '{id}' has a `streamBy` it does not know; pick message or token.
HermesAgent '{id}' runs in a computer, where `program`, a path on your machine, means nothing; leave `program` out, the computer installs Hermes Agent itself.
